root_draft.speaker: agent
root_draft.text: TheForge makes living in a ruined volcanic forge feel like trespassing in something still at work. Fire and water set the colony's working day: gas ignites exposed growth, boiling rain drives people to shelter and floods the ground, and lava briefly becomes a walkable, steaming crust where floatstone gardens grow. The opportunity closes with glowing cracks, drifting gardens and the return of the melt. Its animals belong to that same place: apparent outcrops wake in rain, swarms run on the wet interval, herds and hunters gather around the vapour columns, and a placid dhoggur becomes a fire-spitting danger when attacked. Survival means reading the mountain and making deliberate trips into it; floatstone and its strong, light construction are a reason to risk those trips. The old works must feel present in the experience, while the campaign's tower dungeon, gas monopoly and other lore remain separately owned integrations. Settings let the player tune the built dangers without leaving broken terrain or stranded creatures.

failure_modes: F1 — A hot harvest biome passes its mechanics while the owner's ruined forge never exists in play, and its alien beasts are scenery or generic donor behaviour. Sources: design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md:24; src/RimMandrake/TheForge/About/About.xml; src/RimMandrake/TheForge/Source/RM_ForgeSkyPastures.cs.

F2 — The cycle or wildlife harms a colony without a useful, truthful chance to react: warnings arrive too late, smoke and heat disagree about shelter, tracks fail to predict a giant, or a temporary floor leaves survivors stranded. Sources: src/RimMandrake/TheForge/Source/RM_GameCondition_ForgeCycle.cs; src/RimMandrake/TheForge/Source/RM_ForgePlumeFronts.cs; src/RimMandrake/TheForge/Source/RM_ForgeDhokkurWays.cs.

F3 — The temptation and mastery never pay: scarce floatstone cannot meaningfully advance a project, research is only debug-revealed, or off/load/recovery leaves the world in a broken state. Sources: src/RimMandrake/TheForge/Defs/ThingDefs_Plants/RM_TheForge_Flora.xml; src/RimMandrake/TheForge/Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings/RM_SpunstoneParts.xml; src/RimMandrake/TheForge/validation.py:1730.
